fusions.name: Darting Silverside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darting fish in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. Every cast raises your movement speed by 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flashing Turn
fusions.desc: Sends a twisting jet of water at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Slides you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slipping Into Stride
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
